action.new_text:
def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not np.issubdtype(type(tau_filter), np.floating):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float")

    # Check inputs are 2D arrays
    for name, arr in [
        ("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
        ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
        ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call),
    ]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")

    # Check shape consistency
    n_candidates = logp_with_result.shape[0]
    future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape[1]
    if logp_call_only.shape != (n_candidates, future_horizon):
        raise ValueError("shape mismatch among input matrices")
    if logp_no_call.shape != (n_candidates, future_horizon):
        raise ValueError("shape mismatch among input matrices")

    # T01: compute normalized decreasing future-token weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    sum_raw = np.sum(raw_weights)
    if sum_raw == 0:
        raise ValueError("future horizon yields zero total weight")
    weights = raw_weights / sum_raw

    # T02: compute weighted future-token losses (negative weighted log probs)
    weighted_loss = lambda logp: -np.sum(weights * logp, axis=1)
    L_plus = weighted_loss(logp_with_result)
    L_call_only = weighted_loss(logp_call_only)
    L_empty = weighted_loss(logp_no_call)

    # T03: stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)

    # T04: filtering threshold
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
